Marina 101 is a supertall skyscraper located in the Dubai Marina district of Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Key Architectural & Building Facts
The Crown: The building features a distinct, 45-meter sky-blue angular aluminium crown converging into a four-point pinnacle. An observation lobby sits right below it.

Infrastructure: The tower includes 29 elevators, 6 levels of underground parking, and 5 podium levels accommodating up to 665 vehicles.
